title: How to apply the paqad- skill names
context: Users must see and trigger skills as paqad-ask, paqad-discover, /paqad, etc. The source folders are unprefixed and build.py generates the published manifests from build/skills.yml. The plugin itself is named paqad-product-discovery, which textually contains the skill name product-discovery, so a naive rename is collision-prone. Option A renames all 13 source folders (~120 files incl. 19 tests, 73 docs, REQUIREMENTS). Option B keeps source folders and maps published names in build.py (~15-20 files). Both give users the exact same paqad- names.

options.label: A: rename all 13 source folders with paqad- prefix (literal, source==published, ~120 files)
B: keep source folders, publish paqad- names via build.py mapping (~15-20 files, safer, reversible)

rationale: Owner chose build-time prefix: same user-facing paqad- names with far less source churn and collision risk; source folders stay clean and the change is reversible.
